methods.MT.AGE: Age at Screening Date (Screening Date - Birth date). For the complete algorithm see the referenced external document.
methods.MT.BMISN: round((VSSTRESN for weight/ (VSSTRESN for height / 100)^2), .01). Note: height and weight at the closest visit collected.
methods.MT.CLSIG: Only created if value qualifies as potentially clinically significant high or low based on the high and low ranges specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan.
methods.MT.ECENDY: ECENDY = ECENDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if ECENDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. ECENDTC - RFSTDTC if ECENDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.EXDOSE: If ARMCD=WONDER10 then EXDOSE = Number of Tablets per Day (QVAL where QNAM=SMNO) * 10. If ARMCD=WONDER20 then EXDOSE = Number of Tablets per Day (QVAL where QNAM=SMNO) * 20. If ARMCD=PLACEBO then EXDOSE = 0.
methods.MT.EXDOSU: Derived from ARM, ARMCD - equal to mg
methods.MT.EXENDY: EXENDY = EXENDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if EXENDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. EXENDTC - RFSTDTC if EXENDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.EXSTDY: EXSTDY = EXSTDTC - RFSTDTC+1 if EXSTDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. EXSTDTC - RFSTDTC if EXSTDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.LBBLFL: Safety subjects only: LBBLFL = "Y" for last record with non Null LBORRES on or before the first dose date (RFSTDTC). Null otherwise.
methods.MT.LBDY: LBDY = LBDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if LBDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. LBDTC - RFSTDTC if LBDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.LBNRIND: Reference Range Indicator based upon standard results and ranges.
methods.MT.RACE: Selected value converted to upper case to match CT.
methods.MT.RDOMAIN: Domain abbreviation from where data originated.
methods.MT.RFENDTC: RFENDTC = termination date, for safety subjects. Null for screen failures.
methods.MT.RFSTDTC: RFSTDTC = first date/time of study drug, for safety subject. Null for screen failures.
methods.MT.SAFETY: SAFETY = "Y" for randomized subjects who took at least one dose study medication. Null otherwise.
methods.MT.SEQ: Sequential number identifying records within each USUBJID in the domain.
methods.MT.TSSEQ: Sequential number identifying records within each TSPARM in the domain.
methods.MT.VSBLFL: Safety subjects only: VSBLFL = "Y" for last record with non Null VSORRES on or before the first dose date (RFSTDTC). Null otherwise.
methods.MT.VSDY: VSDY = VSDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if VSDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. VSDTC - RFSTDTC if VSDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.VSSTRESC: Data collected in non-standard units (i.e. lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (kg, cm).
methods.MT.VSSTRESN: VSSTRESN = numeric value of VSSTRESC, when VSSTRESC contains numeric data.
methods.MT.XSBLFL: Safety subjects only: XSBLFL = "Y" for last record with non Null XSORRES on or before the first dose date (RFSTDTC). Null otherwise.
methods.MT.XSDY: XSDY = XSDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if XSDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. XSDTC - RFSTDTC if XSDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.XSSTRESC: Data collected in non-standard units (i.e. lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (kg, cm). BMI is calculated by the EDC system (operationally derived) as follows: round((XSSTRESN for weight/ (XSSTRESN for height / 100)^2), .01). Note: If height is not collected at a visit, use the height collected at screening.
methods.MT.XSSTRESN: XSSTRESN = numeric value of XSSTRESC, when XSSTRESC contains numeric data.
methods.MT.XXBLFL: Safety subjects only: XXBLFL = "Y" for last record with non Null XXORRES on or before the first dose date (RFSTDTC). Null otherwise.
methods.MT.XXDY: XXDY = XXDTC-RFSTDTC+1 if XXDTC is on or after RFSTDTC. XXDTC - RFSTDTC if XXDTC precedes RFSTDTC.
methods.MT.XXSTRESC: Data collected in non-standard units (i.e. lbs, inches) is converted using standard conversion factors to standard units (kg, cm). BMI is calculated by the EDC system (operationally derived) as follows: round((XXSTRESN for weight/ (XXSTRESN for height / 100)^2), .01). Note: If height is not collected at a visit, use the height collected at screening.
methods.MT.XXSTRESN: XXSTRESN = numeric value of XXSTRESC, when XXSTRESC contains numeric data.
